gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
The team is out of ___ after the long break.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of practice' = having lost skill through lack of use.

gaps.sentence: ___ comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
Everything happened ___ such short notice that we panicked.
By all ___ , the festival was a triumph this year.
gaps.explanation: 'By all accounts' = according to what people say.

gaps.sentence: The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.

gaps.explanation: 'from 1 January' = beginning on that date (also 'with effect from').

gaps.sentence: The surgeons operated ___ the light of head-torches when the power failed.
gaps.explanation: 'By the light of' = using the light from something.
